security_audit.summary: All static external-command findings are false positives caused by Markdown code fences, inline backticks, and a JavaScript template literal in SKILL.md. remediation.issue: Nested Markdown code fences trigger external-command scanners.

remediation.issue: The skill promotes viral sharing mechanics without explicit consent guidance.
remediation.suggestion: Add privacy and user-consent guidance for names, birthdays, photos, and social sharing flows.

content.value_statement: Shareable generators often fail because results feel generic or hard to post. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code design quizzes, name tools, avatars, and calculators with clear sharing loops.
actual_capabilities: Defines low-friction input flows for generators, quizzes, name tools, avatars, and calculators.
Outlines result types designed for screenshots, sharing, comparison, identity, and scores.
Provides quiz structure guidance with weighted scoring and desirable result categories.
Shows deterministic name generation patterns using hashed input and reusable name parts.
Identifies weak generator patterns, including generic results, long forms, and bland share cards.
limitations: Does not include a complete production application or deployment workflow.
Does not validate privacy, consent, or legal requirements for collecting photos or personal data.
Does not provide analytics instrumentation, A/B testing setup, or growth measurement code.
Uses illustrative JavaScript snippets and product guidance, not a tested software package.

use_cases.title: Plan a Quiz Campaign
use_cases.description: Map inputs, result categories, and share moments before assigning design or engineering work.

use_cases.title: Build a Name Generator
use_cases.description: Create a deterministic name tool with a result page that stays stable for repeat visitors.

use_cases.title: Improve Social Share Cards
use_cases.description: Turn a generic result screen into a readable, branded card for mobile screenshots and feeds.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Simple Generator
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for a low-friction generator.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the viral-generator-builder skill to design a one-input generator for [audience]. Include input, result types, and a shareable result card concept.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Quiz Flow
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate planning for a personality quiz.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the viral-generator-builder skill to create a seven-question personality quiz for [topic]. Include question types, scoring weights, result categories, and retake flow.

prompt_templates.title: Improve Existing Results
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate audit of an existing concept.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the viral-generator-builder skill to audit this generator concept: [paste concept]. Identify weak sharing moments and rewrite the result page structure.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Launch-Ready Spec
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced product planning for a full generator release.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the viral-generator-builder skill to produce a product spec for [generator idea]. Include data inputs, deterministic logic, result taxonomy, sharing loop, privacy notes, and measurement plan.

output_examples.input: Create a name generator for indie game studios.
output: Input: studio theme or founder name, with an optional style choice.
Result: a deterministic studio name, a short origin story, and a badge-style card.
Sharing loop: compare names with friends and invite them to generate their own.

output_examples.input: Improve a personality quiz about remote work styles.
output: Reduce the quiz to seven image or choice questions.
Create six desirable result types with distinct names and practical advice.
Make the final card readable on mobile and suitable for screenshots.

best_practices: Start with the smallest input set that can still create a personal result.
Make every result specific, positive, and distinct enough to screenshot.
Include privacy and consent checks before collecting names, birthdays, or photos.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for long forms before users see value.
Do not publish generic results that could apply to anyone.
Do not hide the result behind forced sharing or dark patterns.

faq.question: What does this skill help build?
faq.answer: It helps design shareable generators, quizzes, name tools, avatars, calculators, and result pages.

faq.question: Does it generate production code?
faq.answer: No. It provides architecture, examples, and product guidance that a developer can implement.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, or Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill is marked as compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Is it only for personality quizzes?
faq.answer: No. It also covers name generators, text generators, avatar tools, and calculators.

faq.question: How does it handle privacy?
faq.answer: It mentions personal inputs, but teams must define consent, retention, and compliance requirements.

faq.question: What should I provide in a prompt?
faq.answer: Provide the audience, generator type, desired result tone, inputs, and sharing channel.
